SELECT a.id, a.version, a.number, a.name, a.value, a.description, a.is_system, a.feature_id, COALESCE(b.custom_name, b.default_name) AS feature_name, b.app_id, c.name AS app_name FROM t_sys_param a LEFT JOIN t_sys_feature b ON b.id = a.feature_id LEFT JOIN t_sys_app c ON c.id = b.app_id
a.feature_id = #{form.featureId} b.app_id = #{form.appId} c.domain_id = #{form.domainId} a.feature_id IS NULL
AND (a.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{form.keyword}, '%') OR a.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{form.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY ${listQuery.sortColumn} ${listQuery.sortOrder}, a.id ORDER BY a.number, a.id
